record.context_brief: Hausdorff dimension of B_s Diophantine sets
record.original_question: For B_s={(α,β)∈R^2: inf_{n≥1} n(min{||nα||,||nβ||})^s(max{||nα||,||nβ||})^{2−s}>0}, what is the Hausdorff dimension of B_s for 0<s<1?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 47 (Y . Bugeaud). Let Bs = { (α, β) ∈ R2 : inf n≥ 1 n(min{∥nα∥, ∥nβ∥})s(max{∥nα∥, ∥nβ∥})2− s > 0 } . Compute the Hausdorff dimension of the set Bs, 0 < s < 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a real number x, let ‖x‖ denote the distance from x to the nearest integer. For a parameter s with 0 < s < 1, define the set
B_s = { (α, β) ∈ ℝ² : inf_{n ≥ 1} n · (min{‖nα‖, ‖nβ‖})^s · (max{‖nα‖, ‖nβ‖})^{2−s} > 0 }.
Determine the Hausdorff dimension of B_s for every s in the range 0 < s < 1.
artifact.status_search_result: A literature search returns related work on weighted simultaneously badly approximable sets (full Hausdorff dimension results via winning-set arguments and lower bounds on manifolds), but no source computes the Hausdorff dimension of this particular two-dimensional set B_s with the asymmetric weighting (min)^s(max)^{2-s}. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A lower bound for the Hausdorff dimension of the set of weighted simultaneously approximable points over manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Lower bound for Hausdorff dimension of weighted simultaneously approximable points; does not compute the dimension of B_s.
status_evidence.claim: Related weighted-approximation results exist but do not resolve dim B_s.

status_evidence.title: On the Hausdorff Dimension of weighted exactly Approximable Vectors
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Hausdorff dimensions of weighted exactly approximable vectors, but not the specific set B_s.
status_evidence.claim: No matching exact-dimension formula for B_s is given.
